summary: This bill requires Medicare Advantage plan ads, starting one year after enactment, to verbally and visually disclose the number of prior authorization requests denied in the most recent plan year (including those later approved on reconsideration), how many denied requests were approved after reconsideration, and the average days between denial and approval for those.
